_doc: tools/vulncheck.py (SPEC EVL-5). go_targets: module directories govulncheck scans. osv_sources: lockfiles the OSV scan must report (it scans every lockfile; these guard against a scan that reads nothing). skip_paths: the control fixture, scanned only by `vulncheck.py control`, and spikes/, whose Go modules are throwaway experiments that ship nothing (any other go.mod outside go_targets fails the scan). inlined: copies a bundler put in a package's files whose marks give no version, {holder (name@version of the package a lockfile installs), copy (name@version), files (the holder's files that hold it), why (how they were identified)}, or files that copy another installed package's bundle, {holder, bundle (name@version:path), files, why}, which take that bundle's versions and must carry no mark it lacks (#4197); an entry fails once no lockfile installs the holder at that version (#4153), and a file's unversioned bundler mark fails unless a sidecar, notice or entry gives its version. accepted: one record per accepted vulnerability and package version, {id (ID or alias), issue (an open issue naming that id and recording why), why, package and version (the exact copy it accepts: npm package, Go module, or for an image record only the Debian source package), optional where (Go target, lockfile, or "image" for the image's Debian packages, scanned by `vulncheck.py image`; an image record accepts only an advisory Debian has not fixed)}.
